title: スプリンターズSの後に・マイルへ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O overtakes Nishino Flower and obtains victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I resolve to have her race in the Mile Championship, assured she is more than fit to run a mile in her improved state.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O takes a small step forward—from running short sprints to her first mile race!
